activities.title: Listening 2 · Dialogue / interview
activities.passage: Interviewer: Welcome to our school radio programme. Today we are talking to Laila about the outdoor art day. Where will the event happen? Laila: It will take place at the park on Thursday. Our teachers prepared activities for families. Interviewer: Who is helping you organise the event? Laila: My friend Yousuf is helping me, and classmates are arranging tables. Interviewer: What will visitors see first? Laila: They will see a display about a paintbrush. We made it in class. Interviewer: What should visitors bring? Laila: They should bring a reusable water bottle and a notebook. We want to avoid waste. Interviewer: Thank you for sharing your plan. Laila: You are welcome. Interviewer: What did you learn from this experience? Laila: I learned to listen to others, check my work and make better plans. Working together is important because each person has a useful idea.

passages.stem: The art class visited a public park on Thursday morning. Pupils brought paper, pencils and paintbrushes to record what they could see. Their teacher asked them to observe shapes and patterns before drawing. Many students chose flowers and trees near the pathway. This was important for their project.

Another group interviewed people about the colours they liked in public spaces. They listened carefully and wrote short notes. A local artist demonstrated how to draw a simple boat. The pupils practised the steps and compared their first attempts with their final pictures. This was important for their project.

Before leaving the park, everyone displayed their work on a long table. Each child described one decision and one difficulty. The teacher encouraged them to give kind, specific feedback. Later, the pupils carried their pictures back to school and planned a small exhibition. This was important for their project.

activities.passage:
From: laila@school.example
To: yousuf@school.example
Subject: Plans for our class project
Dear Yousuf,
I hope you are enjoying your week. Our class is organising a outdoor art day at the park next Thursday. We will meet at nine in the morning near the main entrance. Our teacher asked each group to prepare one small display and explain it to visiting parents. My group will bring a paintbrush and a poster showing how we made our project. Please bring your notebook, some drinking water and a reusable bag. We do not need to buy new decorations because the school has plenty of materials we can use again. The event finishes at one o'clock. After that, we will tidy the area and return our equipment to the classroom. I hope you can come and help us. Please reply before Sunday.
Best wishes,
Laila
